# Declared faces — K6 runtime view delivery, leg 1 — brief r1

THE PILOT BRIEF: this is the first development leg dispatched as an aion
workflow (dev queue, norn worker). Written floors-not-ceilings: follow the
steps as written; where this brief and the repo's docs disagree, STOP and
report rather than choosing.

## The settled design this implements (do not re-derive)

Ruling 5, DESIGN-EXTENSIONS.md:50-62 (Tom, binding): runtime view delivery —
declare a kind, its view renders, no rebuild. The delivery model is RULED at
ROUND-20260813-VIEW-EYES-WORKFLOWS.md:31-38 (r1.2 bytes-correction): views
travel as RECORD ENTRIES on the registry feed, which the page already folds
live. NO code crosses this seam — declared-form-schema.ts:18-21 is law: "a
facet cannot carry code"; the vocabulary grows by a core release, never by a
declaration. The pattern to copy is the AUTHORING half, already live: the
carried roster is empty (authoring-roster.ts:13-19), forms derive from the
`accepts` facet at runtime, carried-wins on collision
(kind-authoring.ts:135-142).

This leg does the SAME for the rendering half: a kind's DISPLAY face derives
at runtime from a declared face spec — a closed-vocabulary JSON facet — with
the hand-wired poll face surviving as carried-wins. Interactivity (buttons,
actions) is deliberately OUT: that is the K8 interaction door, a later leg.
Declared faces in this leg are read-only display.

## Requirements

**R1 — the face facet.** A component declaration may carry a new facet
`manifold.facet.face@v1`. The core needs NO change: unknown facets travel,
store, and serve verbatim (registry/declaration.rs:69-71) — verify this by
test, not by edit; ⛔ if any crates/ change seems required, STOP-REPORT. The
facet body is `{ "faces": { "<kind-token>": <face-spec> } }`. A face-spec is
`{ "layout": [ <element>... ] }` where each element is one of exactly FOUR
closed primitives (this vocabulary is v1 law, grows only by core release):
- `{ "primitive": "heading", "from": "<field>" }` — the record field rendered
  as the entry's heading text.
- `{ "primitive": "text", "from": "<field>" }` — a field as body text.
- `{ "primitive": "list", "from": "<field>" }` — a list field as items, one
  row each; non-list value = this element refuses (see R4).
- `{ "primitive": "badge", "label": "<literal>", "from": "<field>" }` — a
  small labelled value.
`"from"` names a top-level field of the record body. Unknown primitive names,
missing `from`, or a non-object spec are MALFORMED (R4). deny-unknown-fields
discipline at every level, matching declared-form-schema.ts's reader style.

**R2 — the page derives faces from the record.** New module
`surface/page/src/declared-face.ts` (≤500 LOC, match the house style of
declared-form-schema.ts + kind-authoring.ts): reads mounted declarations
(mounted-registry standing, exactly as record-declaration.ts reads `renders`),
opens `manifold.facet.face@v1`, and yields a `KindFaces` function
(kind-render.ts:97). Composition: in
surface/page/src/composition/conversation/mount.ts, the faces passed to
mountFeedView become carried-first-declared-after — the existing
`pollFaces(...)` answer wins for its tokens; a declared face answers tokens
the carried roster returns null for; both null → existing renderBoundKind
fallback unchanged. This mirrors authorableKinds precedence EXACTLY
(carried first, derived after, carried wins; see the pinned test
composition-declared-form-cases.mjs:584-611 for the precedence shape).

**R3 — live arrival and re-declaration.** Because faces derive from the
mounted-registry fold the page already applies on every registry.feed entry
(record-delivery.ts:87), a newly mounted declaration's face takes effect on
the NEXT render with no rebuild and no reload, and a re-declared face changes
the rendering the same way. Acceptance: a dev-estate walk (never the live
estate) — fixture kind declared with a face renders through it; re-declare
with a changed layout; the rendering changes; the page bundle bytes are
untouched throughout (assert dist/ mtimes or hashes unchanged across the
walk).

**R4 — refusals by name, absence honest.** A malformed face-spec never
half-renders: the kind falls back to renderBoundKind and the malformation is
disclosed the same way authoring derivation refusals are
(authoring-roster.ts's derivationRefusals pattern — find the analogous
surface for render-side disclosure; if none exists, the refusal list is
returned by declared-face.ts and rendered nowhere yet — a stated remainder,
NOT a silent drop; say which in the report). A `list` primitive over a
non-list value refuses that ELEMENT by name, renders the rest. A face naming
a field absent from a given record renders that element as the typed-absence
style already used by kind-render.ts:216-236, never blank.

**R5 — the fixture and the red.** The fixture kind is NOT poll — mint
`ablative.message.notice@v1` (fields: `title` text, `body` text,
`tags` text-list) with a declaration fixture carrying renders + accepts +
face facets, added beside records/polls-declaration.json as
records/notice-declaration.json. RED FIRST: commit a failing case asserting
the declared face's output (heading from title, text from body, list from
tags, badge) BEFORE implementing R2 — the red run's output committed as
evidence in gate-logs/declared-faces/red.log. Then green.

**R6 — pins stay green.** Every existing case in
composition-conversation-cases.mjs, composition-authoring-cases.mjs and
composition-declared-form-cases.mjs passes UNMODIFIED — especially
:1519 (poll kindComponent), :1544 (face never renders undeclared kind),
:2102-2120 (poll declaration pins). ⛔ If any existing pin contradicts a
requirement here, STOP-REPORT with the pin named; never rewrite a pin.

**R7 — gates.** npm run build (tsc + composition build) exit 0; full
composition suite (node scripts/composition-test.mjs) with the new cases
file (scripts/composition-declared-face-cases.mjs) registered the same way
the declared-form cases are; scripts/loc-gate.sh exit 0 (no new debt
entries); scripts/dist-gate.mjs exit 0 (nothing lands in dist/ but build
outputs — the face spec travels on the record, NOT as a served file).
Every exit captured directly to gate-logs/declared-faces/, never through a
pipeline.

## Hard walls

⛔ Live estate untouchable: ports 4176/41100/41101/41102/9490s, every
.manifold* path. Dev estates only. ⛔ No changes under crates/ (STOP-REPORT
if a requirement seems to need one). ⛔ No edits to vendor/, no import-map
changes, no new served files, no dynamic import() of runtime URLs — code
delivery is REFUSED by the settled design; if you find yourself loading
code, you have left the brief. ⛔ poll-face.ts and poll.ts untouched. ⛔ No
lint bypasses, no test skips. Worktree only; never land, merge, push, or
deploy — the re-gate and landing happen at Waffles's desk.

## Provenance

r1 by Waffles 2026-08-14, written against the wiring survey (explorer report,
same date): roster site mount.ts:67-72/:319, faces port kind-render.ts:97,
consumption feed-view.ts:352-371, authoring precedent
authoring-roster.ts/kind-authoring.ts, facet-verbatim law
registry/declaration.rs:69-71, delivery ruling
ROUND-20260813-VIEW-EYES-WORKFLOWS.md:31-38. Amendments land here.

Implemented **Declared faces — K6 runtime view delivery, leg 1** on branch `declared-faces`. Worktree is clean; nothing was landed, merged, pushed, or deployed.

### Commits

- `eef6428` — `test(page): pin declared faces red`
  - Added the failing declared-face browser cases first.
  - Added `records/notice-declaration.json`.
  - Registered `composition-declared-face-cases.mjs`.
  - Committed the required failing transcript:
    - `surface/page/gate-logs/declared-faces/red.log`
    - Exit `1`, with exactly the four new declared-face claims failing.

- `e58973d` — `feat(page): derive display faces from declarations`
  - Added the runtime implementation and final evidence.

### What was built

- Added `surface/page/src/declared-face.ts`:
  - Reads `manifold.facet.face@v1`.
  - Strict, deny-unknown parsing at facet, face-spec, and element levels.
  - Closed v1 vocabulary:
    - `heading`
    - `text`
    - `list`
    - `badge`
  - Malformed face specs return no face, preserving `renderBoundKind` fallback.
  - Missing record fields render an explicit typed absence naming the field.
  - A `list` over a non-list value refuses only that element by field name; remaining elements render.
  - Preserves bound-kind provenance and attribution.
  - Resolves against a fresh mounted-registry snapshot on every token request.
  - Exposes `declaredFaceRefusals(snapshot)` for malformed-declaration disclosure.

- Updated conversation composition:
  - Existing `pollFaces(...)` remains carried-first.
  - Declared faces answer only when the carried roster returns `null`.
  - Both returning `null` leaves the existing bound-kind fallback unchanged.
  - The page’s existing mounted-registry fold is reused; no second registry reading was introduced.

- Added fixture:
  - `surface/page/records/notice-declaration.json`
  - Kind: `ablative.message.notice@v1`
  - Fields: `title`, `body`, `tags`
  - Carries renders, accepts, and face facets.

- Added and registered browser coverage:
  - Unknown face facets pass through the existing declaration reader verbatim.
  - All four primitives render.
  - Malformed specs refuse whole and disclose the primitive/reason.
  - Missing-field and list-type behavior.
  - Fresh declaration and re-declaration layouts affect the next resolver answer.
  - Existing composition pins remained unmodified.

  - Five existing debts.
  - None grown or stale; no new over-limit files.
- `dist.log` — dist gate:
  - 140 served files regenerated byte-identically.
  - No tracked or committable dist output.
- `live-redeclaration.log` — declaration/re-declaration browser walk:
  - 442 dist files before and after.
  - `page bundle bytes unchanged: true`.

These are local committed transcripts; the server’s four mechanical R7 re-gates remain authoritative and are not claimed here.
